units.title: Workshop Layout and Safety
topics: - Understand the layout of a metallurgical workshop. - Equipment placement
safety zones. - Types of fires (class A, B, C)
fire extinguishers, and emergency procedures. - Use of gloves
aprons, and hearing protection. - Proper handling and disposal of metal scraps
chemicals, and other waste materials. - Create a safety checklist and conduct a mock safety drill

units.title: Metal Identification and Shaping Techniques
topics: - Learn to identify common metals by their physical properties. - Bending
hammering, and shearing. - Demonstrate each technique and then practice on metal samples to achieve specific shapes

units.title: Sheet Metal Work and Heat Sources
topics: edging, and riveting. - Prepare a simple sheet metal project using these techniques
such as a small utility box. - Gas burners and electric furnaces. - Demonstrate the operation of each heat source and conduct a controlled heating experiment

units.title: Joining, Pattern making and Metallography
topics: safety equipment. - Procedure for arc welding technique. - Preparing patterns and casting metal. - Patterns used in casting. - Sample preparation
